scope: Native URL leaf, graph-only rekey evidence; no physical URL rewrite
conditions: MediaWiki-exact URL title, only exact unique slots 1 and optional 2; named key trim is ASCII only
Nonempty HTTP(S), protocol-relative or hostname/path literal; no entities, percent encodings, source programs or tags
Only external DNS hosts; Portuguese Wikipedia canonical, mobile and other pt subdomains are held
Optional plain literal label; relative, ambiguous, credential-bearing and unproved calls are held
Only top-level source calls outside protected/HTML/template/link/table/reference owners contribute to the graph view
Source length, offsets and complete raw reference inventory are identical; all prior rekey predicates remain on original source
